Metadata cache API, sequence helpers, and wait/publish macros for fragment publication.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_mcache` interface, which is a shared-memory metadata cache for fragment publication and consumption. It provides macros for alignment, memory footprint, sequence storage, and metadata layout, plus functions to create, join, leave, and delete an mcache region. The file also defines accessors and inline helpers for sequence queries, sequence updates, line index mapping, metadata publication, and bounded wait operations for consumers. SSE and AVX variants are included when supported, so producers and consumers can use vectorized loads and stores for the fragment metadata.
